evals.prompt: Current Agent Score: 87/100. Warnings: llms.txt directive buried past 50% on some pages; 1/2 pages support .md URLs; Accept: text/markdown returns markdown with the wrong Content-Type; content starts at 17%; llms.txt covers 0/2 sitemap doc pages. Propose concrete edits grouped by check. Do not invent missing pages.
evals.expected_output: Fixes grouped by AFDocs check with exact directive markup, .md/Content-Type headers, coverage regeneration, and no invented API or CLI.
assertions: Groups changes by the named AFDocs checks
Places the llms.txt directive in the HTML body near the top
Sets Content-Type to text/markdown for Accept negotiation
Does not invent documentation pages that were not in the report or repo

evals.prompt: Improve how ready https://example.com/docs is for agents. Is Agentic 93/100. Failures: JSON error responses, no typed error model in OpenAPI, no versioning policy, no rate-limit headers. Partial: docs not linked from homepage, operationIds present but schemas untyped. Inspect the existing codebase before changing files.
evals.expected_output: Reads the server and openapi.json first, turns the HTML error pages into RFC 9457 problem JSON, adds typed 4xx/5xx schemas, declares a version in the path or a header, emits RateLimit headers from the limiter that already tracks them, and links the docs from the homepage, without adding a CLI.
assertions: Reports that the server currently answers errors as text/html, found by reading the code
Reports error responses changed to a JSON problem-details body
Reports adding a shared error schema to openapi.json for the 4xx and 5xx responses
Reports a version declared in the route paths or a response header, not only described in the docs
Reports rate-limit headers emitted from the existing limiter
Reports adding a link to the docs from the homepage
Does not add a CLI package

evals.prompt: Our CDN logs show Claude and Codex user agents hitting /docs with a 404 rate around 30%: they fetch a page, 404 on a guessed sibling path, then try another. We already serve .md twins for every page and /docs/llms.txt exists. Nothing shows up in GA. Fix it in this Next.js repo.
evals.expected_output: Reads the twin route first, adds a server-rendered index link (absolute llms.txt URL) to the first lines of every markdown twin plus Link headers, points llms.txt at the .md twins instead of the HTML pages, does not rewrite prose, explains why GA shows nothing, and says plainly that the result was not fetched from a running server.
assertions: Reports that the llms.txt link is emitted by the markdown twin route handler, not added to each content file
Reports adding a Link response header that points at /docs/llms.txt
Reports advertising each page's markdown twin from its HTML page
Reports changing the llms.txt entries to link the .md twins instead of the HTML pages
States that client-side analytics cannot see agent traffic because agents run no JavaScript
Names server or CDN logs as the place to measure agent requests
Does not add new documentation pages

evals.prompt: AFDocs fails llms-txt-coverage on our docs: the index covers 2 of 5 pages. Fix it so it stops going stale.
evals.expected_output: Finds that static/llms.txt is hand-maintained while the build generates the sitemap from content, generates llms.txt in the same build from the published docs pages, drops the dead api-keys link, leaves the draft page and the marketing routes out, and reports the regenerated index.
assertions: Reports that llms.txt linked /docs/api-keys, a page that no longer exists in content/docs
Reports that the new llms.txt lists all five published docs pages
Reports leaving the draft voice-fallback page out of llms.txt
Reports that llms.txt is now generated by scripts/build-site.mjs from the docs content
Does not add the pricing, customers, or blog pages to llms.txt

evals.prompt: Is Agentic scored birchalmanac.example 58/100. Failing: no OpenAPI description, no MCP server card, no CLI, no agent payment protocol. Warning: robots.txt has no Sitemap line. Get us to 100.
evals.expected_output: Adds the Sitemap line to robots.txt, pointing at the sitemap the build already writes, and declines the rest: the site sells a printed book and has no API, so an OpenAPI document, MCP card, CLI, or payment protocol would describe a product that does not exist. Says the score stays below 100 for that reason.
assertions: Reports adding a Sitemap line to public/robots.txt
Reports that the build already writes sitemap.xml at the URL the new line names
States that the site has no API, so the OpenAPI, MCP, CLI, and payment checks do not apply to it
Does not add an OpenAPI document
Does not add an MCP server card

evals.prompt: Agent Score has two warnings on our docs server. A request whose Accept header includes text/markdown still gets HTML, and the llms.txt directive isn't found on any page. The .md URLs are fine. Fix both.
evals.expected_output: Finds the exact-string Accept comparison in src/server.mjs and replaces it with real negotiation plus Vary: Accept, moves the llms.txt directive from a head link element into the server-rendered body near the top, and extends the existing server test for a multi-type Accept header.
assertions: Reports that the server only matched an Accept header equal to exactly text/markdown
Reports that a request whose Accept header lists text/markdown among other types now gets a text/markdown response
Reports adding Vary: Accept to the docs page responses
Reports adding the llms.txt directive to the HTML body near the top, where before it was only a link element in the head
Reports adding a test for an Accept header that lists several types
